[[File:Gamorrean_Frilled_Leatheris_belt.jpg|150px|thumb|[[Vette]] wearing a Gamorrean frilled leatheris belt]]
A '''Gamorrean frilled leatheris belt''' was an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the fabric [[leatheris]] and consisted of a [[Black (disambiguation)|black]] length of the material with several metallic clips and hanging discs attached.
